name: pump_feature_extractor
summary: Pure-stdlib (Polars-optional) feature kernel that consumes the JSONL output of pump_stream_ingest.py (parallel agent A) and produces a 10-column behavioral feature DataFrame ready for GMM + XGBoost classification of bot vs human pump.fun wallets. Groups events by `payer`, anchors a window at the wallet's most recent event and walks backward `window_seconds`, drops wallets with fewer than `min_events_per_wallet` events, and computes ten orthogonal axes that each exhibit a different bot-vs-human signature. Polars is the canonical path; when polars is absent, a tiny `_PolarsFallback` wrapper around a dict-of-lists supports the subset of the API the module needs (.select/.with_columns/.filter/.to_dicts/.write_csv/.height) so downstream code and smoke runs work either way. The funding_proximity feature is the only one with an external dependency — it shells out to `solana transaction-history --limit 1 <wallet>` via subprocess; if the CLI is absent or RPC is unreachable, it returns -1 (stub fallback) and the rest of the row is still produced.
engine_pattern: Stream-decode JSONL → group by payer → sort by ts → anchor window at last ts → compute 10 features per wallet. Each kernel is a small pure function over a flat list of values; no numpy/pandas/polars math primitives are required, only python stdlib (math, statistics-style sums, dict counters). The DataFrame is constructed only at the very end so the rest of the module is allocator-agnostic.

features.tx_per_block: mean transactions/block in window — bots emit ~constant rate; humans irregular
features.tx_per_block_var: variance of tx-per-block density — bots low, humans high (only discriminates when bots batch multiple txs into one slot; synthetic single-tx-per-slot data shows 0 for both, which is expected)
features.value_entropy: Shannon entropy of log10-binned sol_amount values, in bits — bots low (e.g. 0.0 for constant 0.05 SOL buys); humans high (≥2 bits for organic chaos)
features.benford_distance: KS distance of leading-digit distribution vs Benford's expected log10(1+1/d) — bots emit round amounts (0.05, 0.1, 1.0) so leading digit collapses to {1,5} → high distance (≈0.7); humans emit organic amounts → close to Benford → low distance (≈0.1)
features.funding_proximity: blocks between wallet's first ever tx and its first pump.fun buy — bots bundle-funded → tiny delta; humans aged wallet → huge delta; -1 means RPC unreachable / not enabled
features.gas_distortion: std(priority_fee) / mean(priority_fee) — coefficient of variation; bots formulaic → near 0; humans chaotic → high
features.jito_bundle_ratio: fraction of txs with jito_tip_lamports > 0 — bots ~1.0; humans ~0.0
features.buy_sell_balance: |buys - sells| / total — bots pumping/dumping skew toward 1.0; humans mixed toward 0.0
features.unique_mints_touched: count of distinct mints — sniper bots target 1 mint; humans touch many

api.main_function: extract_features(jsonl_paths, window_seconds=300, min_events_per_wallet=3, solana_rpc_url=None, rpc_enabled=False) -> polars.DataFrame | _PolarsFallback

polars_or_fallback.canonical: polars — when `import polars as pl` succeeds, extract_features returns a real pl.DataFrame and to_training_csv calls df.write_csv(str(path))
polars_or_fallback.fallback: _PolarsFallback — a stdlib dict-of-lists wrapper exposing .columns, .height, .__len__, .to_dicts, .select, .with_columns, .filter, .write_csv. Constructed when polars is absent. Exists only so smoke runs anywhere; the downstream GMM/XGBoost trainer should depend on polars and the fallback is not feature-complete for joins.
polars_or_fallback.rationale: MySpace++ smoke environments don't ship numpy/polars/scipy. Mirroring sui_mcp's stdlib-first stance keeps the connector loadable in the bare studio venv. When polars is present, behavior is identical to the canonical path.
polars_or_fallback.detected_at_runtime: _POLARS_AVAILABLE module-level flag; printed at CLI runtime as 'polars: present' or 'polars: fallback (stdlib only)'

external_dependency.stub_fallback: FileNotFoundError | TimeoutExpired | non-zero returncode | unparseable stdout → returns -1
external_dependency.rpc_disabled_default: extract_features(rpc_enabled=False) skips the subprocess entirely and stores -1; flip to True only when running against a host with the `solana` CLI on PATH

input_format.shape: JSONL — one event per line, produced by pump_stream_ingest.py (parallel agent A)
input_format.malformed_lines: silently skipped (json.JSONDecodeError → continue); missing wallet (payer) → skipped

window_semantics: window anchors at the wallet's MOST RECENT observed ts and walks backward window_seconds. This snapshots the latest behavior per wallet rather than aligning to a global wall clock — important when streams ingest at uneven rates.
substrate: no per-call on-disk state. Reads only the JSONL paths passed in. to_training_csv writes one features.csv (caller-provided path) for downstream GMM + XGBoost training. No crystal records, no inference logger — this is a pure feature kernel.

inbound_callers: (planned) GMM + XGBoost trainer notebook in studio/passes/
outbound_calls: (no inference_logger, no crystal chain, no DB writes — pure compute kernel)

guarantees: Stdlib-only (math, json, subprocess, csv, collections, pathlib, argparse) — polars optional with graceful _PolarsFallback
No pip installs — runs in the bare studio venv
Pure feature kernel — no side effects beyond optional --out CSV write
Funding-proximity RPC is opt-in (rpc_enabled=False default) — stub returns -1 if disabled or unreachable
Wallets with fewer than min_events_per_wallet events are dropped (no degenerate single-tx rows)
Empty input → empty DataFrame with the correct 11-column schema (downstream joins are still safe)
Malformed JSONL lines are silently skipped (json.JSONDecodeError → continue)
Window anchors at the wallet's last ts (per-wallet recent snapshot), not at a global clock
Touches NONE of: pump_stream_ingest, solana_mcp, cc.sh, .env, model_api — pure consumer of JSONL
usage_example:
from pathlib import Path
from core.lib.pump_feature_extractor import extract_features, to_training_csv
df = extract_features(
    jsonl_paths=[Path.home() / '.cc/pump_stream/live.jsonl'],
    window_seconds=300,
    min_events_per_wallet=5,
)
to_training_csv(df, Path('studio/assets/pump_features.csv'))
cli_example:
python3 core/lib/pump_feature_extractor.py extract \
    --jsonl ~/.cc/pump_stream/live.jsonl \
    --window 600 \
    --min-events 3 \
    --out studio/assets/pump_features.csv

# with funding_proximity RPC enabled
python3 core/lib/pump_feature_extractor.py extract \
    --jsonl ~/.cc/pump_stream/live.jsonl \
    --window 600 --min-events 3 \
    --rpc-enabled --rpc https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com
constraints_honored: ONLY one new module file + this card — no edits to pump_stream_ingest, solana_mcp, cc.sh, .env, model_api
Stdlib only; polars optional with graceful fallback (smoke confirms fallback path works)
No KINDS widening in studio/auth/keys.py (this module reads no secrets)
phase: pump.fun bot detection pipeline, feature-engineering primitive (consumer of agent A's stream ingester, producer for downstream GMM + XGBoost classifier)
